tests.title: Logout invalidates the session token
tests.goal: A copied session token stops working after logout.

steps.text: Log in as the QA user in a separate HTTP session and keep the session cookie
Log out (signout)
Call /api/auth/session and an API with the kept cookie

expected.text: The old cookie is rejected after logout

notes: Copied cookie rejected after signout: empty expired session, templates 401.

tests.title: Deleting a user ends their sessions

steps.text: As admin delete the QA user
With the QA user's existing session, open /templates and call the templates API

expected.text: The old session is rejected (401/redirect to /login)

tests.title: Editing message text or buttons keeps the app and Twilio the same
tests.goal: What the app shows as the message is what members receive.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session, or TWW_QA_ADMIN_USER / TWW_QA_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

A Twilio draft template owned by that admin: only the owner can save the edit page (PATCH checks createdBy), so "testing" (admin@tungwah.org) works only when logged in as admin@tungwah.org. Otherwise create a throwaway draft qa_edit_<unique> with 創建後立即提交 Meta 審核 unticked (it is ticked by default). Creating and deleting a Twilio draft needs the user's approval per run (README > Testing permissions).
data: New body text: QA edited body <unique>

steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000/templates/<template id>/edit (no link in the app; type the URL)
Change the body text and one button title, then click 保存修改
Compare the template detail page with the same content in the Twilio console (Messaging > Templates > the template)
Click 從 Twilio 同步 and open the template again
Restore or clean up: delete the throwaway draft with 刪除 (also deletes it in Twilio), or put the original text of testing back

expected.text: The edit page is not offered for Twilio templates, or
the change also reaches Twilio, so the app and Twilio show the same text and buttons
a sync does not silently undo an edit

notes: Twilio draft content fields disabled and explanatory warning shown; content PATCH 400; Twilio unchanged. Draft cleaned up.

tests.title: Editor can see every template's contacts and report
tests.goal: Editors work on all campaigns, not only their own.
preconditions: Admin account (TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)
The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer checks, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用戶 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: As admin create a draft template qa_owner_<unique> (Meta unticked) and upload the contacts file to it
Log out and log in as the QA editor
On 消息模版 click 從 Twilio 同步
Click the qa_owner_<unique> card and open 聯繫人
Click 下載報表
Log back in as admin and delete qa_owner_<unique> (cleanup)

expected.text: After sync the editor's list shows qa_owner_<unique> and the other templates
The template page, the contacts page (QA Tester with phone and member data) and the report download work

notes: Shared template and contacts now open; editor export of admin-owned template still 404 {error:模板不存在}, reproduced twice. Creator-only check remains in export route.
Tracking split only: the confirmed export 404 is now BUG-044, superseding the remaining part of BUG-038. No new execution or result change.

At least one approved template with sent contacts, one failed contact and one reply this month

Open 儀表板

tests.title: Contact status follows Twilio delivery and read receipts
tests.goal: The app shows Delivered / Read / Undelivered like Twilio does.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
ngrok tunnel for the Twilio webhook running

steps.text: Make sure the Twilio status webhook reaches the app (ngrok tunnel up)
Send the QA contact (mapped)
Open the message on the phone
Open 聯繫人 and click 刷新

expected.text: After delivery the contact shows a delivered state and time; after opening it shows read
A message to a non-HK number that Twilio marks Undelivered shows as failed, not 已發送

notes: Real send DELIVERED at 06:48:20Z and READ at 06:49:44Z, both timestamps populated; Twilio read. Correctly signed synthetic undelivered replay on disposable QA contact: 200, FAILED/63058/failedAt. No external failed-delivery send.

Retested attached report against build 1cdd076 via our ngrok tunnel. Five report bugs verified; BUG-038/039 partially fixed with shared export 404 and viewer write controls remaining. New BUG-043 covers local-only template omission. TWW-085 partly covered but excluded: editor live Twilio deletion not exercised. Delivery/read were real; failure callback was signed synthetic replay on disposable data. Setup repaired with explicit approval; all temporary QA data cleaned up.
